club_info.title: The Association
club_info.watermark_sub: Everything for the plant - Everything for the club
club_info.description: We are a non-commercial association, based in Buchholz in der Nordheide, which is financed by membership fees. Now, after receiving the license, we as Cannabis Social Club Nordheide will focus exclusively on providing our members with comprehensive information and providing a limited quantity of high-quality cannabis products for personal consumption within legal requirements. We place particular emphasis on a professional and sustainable way of working, a special, exclusive selection of strains and high-quality products for our members!

safety.title: Stay Safe
safety.subtitle: Protected Space
safety.description: As Cannabis Social Club Nordheide, we attach great importance to prevention, youth protection and health protection. Our prevention officer ensures that all measures to protect members are complied with and offers support for members with problematic consumption behavior.
safety.warning: Please note that the purchase of cannabis products will be exclusively reserved for our valued members. Inquiries regarding the acquisition of cannabis products without the intention of joining our association will remain unanswered on our part. As a responsible association, we attach the greatest importance to the safety and satisfaction of our members. We decisively distance ourselves from illegal activities and commit ourselves to conscientiously complying with the strict requirements of the Cannabis Act.

hero.title: Membership Applications
hero.description: Submit your membership application now and become part of CSC Nordheide e.V. Choose between the free standard membership or the supporter membership with exclusive advantages.

standard.name: Standard Membership
standard.description: For the standard membership, the admission fee is waived completely. Included in the standard membership:
features: Access to the standard range (flower and hashish products)
Obtaining cuttings for home cultivation (coming soon)
No access to test genetics (cannabis flowers)
Upgrade to supporter membership is possible at any time

supporter.name: Supporter Membership
supporter.description: For the supporter membership, a one-time admission fee of 300,-€ is payable. The supporter membership includes:
features: A premium cutting for homegrow every 6 months (optional)
Exclusive access to limited test genetics (cannabis flowers)
Reservation possibility for favorite strains (coming soon)
An official CSC Nordheide e.V. polo shirt/T-shirt
